lead.description: a requirement that every combination of quasi-identifiers in a released table appears at least k times

self_checks.title: Minimum frequency
self_checks.prompt: Three rows share one quasi-identifier pair and one row has a different pair. What is the minimum frequency?
self_checks.answer: The minimum frequency is 1, so the table is not 2-anonymous.

self_checks.title: After one added row
self_checks.prompt: A second row with the rare pair is added. What is the minimum frequency, and is the table 2-anonymous?
self_checks.answer: The minimum frequency is 2, so the table satisfies 2-anonymity.
